messages:
Raj (ACME): Hey @Maya — our client tried to open an SSE connection to the /v1/rerank endpoint and gets 415 immediately. Happens with our Node client and curl. We relied on streaming for other endpoints; thought rerank supported it.

Maya (Support): sorry about that — can you paste the exact request you sent and one full response (headers + body)? Also your account id and a sample request id if present so we can trace.

Raj (ACME): account: acme-prod-42. Here's a repro curl we ran (sanitized):

```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
     -H "Content-Type: text/event-stream" \
     -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank \
     -d '{"queries":["Which policy is newest?"], "documents":["docA","docB","docC"]}'
```

Response (raw):

HTTP/1.1 415 Unsupported Media Type
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":"unsupported_media_type","message":"Content-Type text/event-stream not supported for rerank; use application/json"}

Tom (Eng-ML): thanks, that makes sense. Rerank is not a streaming endpoint — it returns a single JSON payload with scores. The server expects Content-Type: application/json and a regular POST. If the client sets `text/event-stream` we treat it as streaming input and return 415. We should make that clearer in docs / error message.

Maya (Support): Raj, please try this non-streaming curl to confirm behavior:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank \
     -d '{"queries":["Which policy is newest?"], "documents":["docA","docB","docC"]}'
```

Expected response: 200 with JSON like `{"scores":[0.12,0.55,0.33]}` or `{"results":[{"id":"docB","score":0.55},...]}` depending on SDK.

Raj (ACME): ok trying now...

ops-bot: trace attach: request_id=rr_0a7c3f, path=/v1/rerank, peer_ip=52.12.34.56, ct_in=text/event-stream, status=415, latency_ms=18

Lena (Eng-Oncall): I see those traces. Also noticing a spike of these 415s after a client rollout. Filing an internal follow-up: we should return a clearer human message and maybe a 400 instead of 415 in this case — but 415 is fine technically.

Tom (Eng-ML): quick note on semantics: rerank is synchronous — streaming doesn't make sense because the model scores a closed set and we return a single ranking payload. We'll patch the docs to explicitly state "no SSE / no streaming" and add a snippet showing correct headers.

Ivy (Billing): flagged: customer reported unexpected billing increase tied to the rollout. Please attach the request slice for account `acme-prod-42` between 2026-03-10T09:00Z and 2026-03-10T10:00Z. Failed 4xx requests should not be charged; we'll audit and credit if any were incorrectly billed.

Maya (Support): @Ivy — attaching the request IDs from logs: rr_0a7c3f, rr_0a7c5a, rr_0a7c90 (all 415). Raj, can you confirm if your client retried on error? Retries could generate extra tokens/requests even if 415 is returned.

Raj (ACME): we had an automatic retry on network errors only — but our wrapper treats any non-200 as retry. So yes, it retried 3x by default. We'll disable retries for 4xx.

Tom (Eng-ML): action items from eng side: (1) update error message to include "rerank does not support streaming; set Content-Type: application/json" (2) add docs example blocking SSE for rerank and clarify SDK behavior (3) add a server-side guard to avoid counting token usage for 4xx failures in billing pipeline — but need billing to confirm.

Ivy (Billing): we'll run a quick audit and if we see charges tied to those request_ids we'll refund. Please share a billing contact at ACME and any invoice ids.

Maya (Support): workaround summary for ACME — change client to send `Content-Type: application/json` and POST non-streaming. Disable automatic retries on 4xx. If you really need streaming semantics, implement client-side streaming that batches requests to rerank and streams aggregated results to your users.

Raj (ACME): thanks — we'll flip the header and remove retries, retest in 15m and report back. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Tom (Eng-ML): I'll follow up with a docs PR and a small server change to make the 415 message more actionable; ETA today.

Maya (Support): leaving this open until you confirm it's fixed on your side, @Raj. If billing issue persists we'll keep Ivy looped. :thumbsup:

Raj (ACME): confirmed — after header fix and disabling retries, requests succeed and we get expected scores. No further errors for now. Thanks everyone.
